title: Toddler Girl with Teddy Bear in Backyard, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid 1950s black-and-white square snapshot featuring a young girl with blonde pigtails standing barefoot in a spacious grassy backyard while hugging a dark stuffed teddy bear. The backdrop shows a suburban yard complete with a wooden fence, flowerbeds, and shady trees, representing idyllic postwar American family life.
